maddeler.e:
اقتحمت (form VIII)
# اِقْتَحَمْتُ (iqtaḥamtu) /iq.ta.ħam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اِقْتَحَمْتَ (iqtaḥamta) /iq.ta.ħam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اِقْتَحَمْتِ (iqtaḥamti) /iq.ta.ħam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اِقْتَحَمَتْ (iqtaḥamat) /iq.ta.ħa.mat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
